reference.title: How to Build an AI Agent that Scrapes Viral News! (n8n tutorial)

steps: Read curated primary, reporting, newsletter, repository, Reddit, and Hacker News feeds.
Normalize URLs and discard stale feed entries before full-text enrichment.
Extract the article body into compact plain text instead of passing raw HTML to the model.
Create a structured record containing headline, publisher, publication date, source URL, source role, summary, entities, and category.
Cluster duplicate coverage and compute recency, engagement, breadth, evidence, consequence, and visual-demonstrability scores.
Treat newsletters and community attention as momentum signals, never as sole factual evidence.
Require primary evidence or independent reporting before a story can enter a script.
Store the ranked records for weekly and daily editorial review.

preferred: multiple independent publishers covering the same event
official launch with a demonstrable product change
strong community discussion confirmed by primary evidence
reject: old articles resurfacing without a material update
high engagement with no usable visual proof
